git_reflog.description: View the reference logs (reflog) to track when branch tips and other references were updated. Useful for recovering lost commits.

maxCount.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-1000).

path.description: Path to the Git repository. Defaults to session working directory set via git_set_working_dir.

ref.description: Reference whose reflog to show. Defaults to HEAD. Must not start with "-".
